text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?
Daniel, sit down if you want. No, that wasn’t about you. We were talking about some viral clip from last week. I didn’t even think about last Sunday. Why would I bring that up here?

Uh, okay... I just thought, since it happened to me in the match and you were there, it sounded pretty similar. Maybe it’s just a weird coincidence. Sorry if I jumped to conclusions. I just felt a bit weird hearing it, you know?

No worries, man. I get why you’d feel that way, honestly. It was just bad timing, I guess. I really wasn’t trying to poke fun at you. If I’d meant you, I would’ve just said it straight up. Are we good?

Yeah, we’re good. Thanks for saying that. I probably should’ve just asked instead of assuming. That moment on Sunday is still stuck in my head, so I guess I’m a bit sensitive about it. Let’s just leave it. Want another drink?
Glad we sorted it out. And I get it, that kind of miss would bother anyone. Sure, I’ll take another drink, thanks. What are you having? Maybe we can toast to better luck next match.
I’m just having a beer. I can get you one too, if that’s alright? And yeah, let’s definitely toast to better luck. I could use it. I appreciate you not making a big deal out of this, by the way.
A beer sounds good, thanks. And really, no reason to make things bigger than they are. We all mess up sometimes, right? Next game, it’ll go in for sure. Let’s just enjoy the evening.
